notes.title: Hotfix - 1
notes.content:
Fixed a critical bug in the ‘Commander’ boss battle
Drones flying vertically on the highest difficulty are not destroyed

notes.title: We are pleased to present you an updated demo version of our game!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44308272/cdb2b903f6e0fcc802c3fc593f90386adf569cb6.gif[/img]
Localisations in Portuguese-Brazilian, Chinese (simplified) and Russian have been added. Machine translation was used for translation, so there may be some inaccuracies in the text.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44308272/0d18e793038506c34e03f0bf34831632ecc04095.gif[/img]
Platforming mechanics have also been improved: now the player has time to jump if he accidentally slips off the platform.
In addition, we fixed the mechanics of sliding, which can now be activated by a separate button. This makes it much easier to perform difficult jumps.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44308272/cc39cc54a6c8996d5fe36ae7db8e1bb9edcd5757.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44308272/7c171e6653795af73b059d319357dcfd8d01a92a.gif[/img]
Shooting upwards and fixing the character's rotation has also been added.

[h3]The game is scheduled for release on November 19.[/h3]

notes.title: Demo updated!
notes.content:
[h2]What's new?[/h2]

[b]We received feedback from the first players and fixed some annoying things:[/b]

[list]
[*] Now, there is an autosave in the upgrade terminal menu and some levels
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44308272/09d5804b597499bce455c049b1a879c8f49b7b26.gif[/img]
[*] F12 screenshot function in Steam
[*] Additive indication when the ammo runs out
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44308272/67b5f2a2fcd144c13940c76e777e9581004f67bf.gif[/img]
[*] Extremely difficult platforming sections are fixed
[*] Dropped weapons now stay on the ground. You can pick it up again
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44308272/24a17a42fd06b82f5a09878e718a17d7471cbb37.gif[/img]
[*] Fixed button designations in the control menu
[*] Full support for Dual Shock 4 (disable Steam input system)
[/list]

notes.title: Cybertrash STATYX DEMO out now!
notes.content:
[h3]We happy to present the DEMO version of Cybertrash STATYX![/h3]

Feel the main mechanics of the game. Try 3 [b]different modes[/b], 5 types of [b]weapons[/b], [b]upgrade [/b]your character's first skills. Immerse yourself in the [b]storyline[/b]. Fight the first enemies and defeat the boss.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44308272/ae9d9ddc29e9adba736dbe1a5588259a6de96014.png[/img]

[b]You can try right now![/b]
